parse.title: Illusionist (Fusion)
parse.text:
Overview

Illusionist (Fusion) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable through evolving Illusionist (Chrysalis).

Evolving

Illusionist (Fusion) can be evolved from Illusionist (Chrysalis) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Illusionist (Chrysalis)
Result
Illusionist (Fusion)
  • You also need to at least kill 5000 enemies during Illusionist (Chrysalis) form and 62.5% awakening.
  • To get Worthy Souls (each Worthy Soul has 0.5% awakening), you need to either clear Spirit Town - Act 6 (Legend Stage), or by sacrificing MythicalMythical units for 12.5% each.
  • Illusionist (Fusion) can be evolved into Illusionist (Final)

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
